title.narrative: Development of a Police Reform project in Ukraine
Utveckling av ett polisreformprojekt i Ukraina

description.narrative: Förstudie avseende utveckling av ett polisreformprojekt i Ukraina
Inception phase on cooperation for development of a Police Reform project in Ukraine

PART I: FEASIBILITY STUDY DELIVERABLES/EXPECTED RESULTS That all involved partners have gained enough insight into the possibilities, needs, risks and interests for a bilateral police assistance programme between the Swedish Police Autority and the National Police of Ukraine.
PART II: PROJECT DESIGN DELIVERABLES/EXPECTED RESULTS The direct output of the programme design phase is a programme document that defines the objectives, expected results and theory of change of the programme. The document will form the basis of a longterm development cooperation programme between the Swedish Police Autority and the National Police of Ukraine, addressing the main reform needs in the suggested cooperation areas.
